branded.why: The Swedish cheese pushed up out of its tube, a Swedish breakfast fixture since 1947.

about.text: A Swedish soft cheese packed in a waxed cardboard tube and pushed up out of it to be sliced with a string attached to the tube. It was launched in 1947, and Kavli relaunched it in 2019 as Mjuk Raketost on the same basic recipe.

sources.text: The packaging, the launch, the end of production in 1979 and the 2019 relaunch, from this article.
